items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1959-12-09
items.q: We stopped in Baton Rouge, took Johnson and all them, got on board and we traded them there.

ctx.x: Man, I made so much money. Dr. William give us $20 a piece to have fun with. I didn't know what to do with money then. I just put pocket that money in. I had some fun, but I didn't know nothing about spending no big money then. So we had a time. Frankie and all of them come down and enjoyed themselves. Man, so one morning, the first morning, Ed went down to see when they were going to leave. He said, all right, Ed, say, have everybody aboard for about 11 o'clock. He said, just get on the train and you know where…
We stopped over there. The whole club and everybody. No, the band.
